created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the API Key was created.

created_by.description:
The ID and type of the actor that created the API key, or `null` when the
creator is not recorded (legacy, workload-identity-federated, or
system-created keys).

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the API Key expires, or `null` if it never expires.

partial_key_hint.title: Partial Key Hint
partial_key_hint.description: Partially redacted hint for the API key.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: The principal the API key acts as (a User or a Service Account), or `null` if the API key is not bound to a principal.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Where the API key belongs: its Workspace (`{"type": "workspace", "workspace_id": "wrkspc_..."}`, with the Workspace's real ID even when it is the organization's default Workspace), or the organization (`{"type": "organization"}`) for a principal-bound API key that has no Workspace.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Object type.

For API Keys, this is always `"api_key"`.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Deprecated: use `scope` instead. ID of the Workspace associated with the API key, or `null` if the API key belongs to the default Workspace. Also `null` for a principal-bound API key that has no Workspace; `scope` tells the two apart.
workspace_id.x-stainless-deprecation-message: Use `scope` instead. `workspace_id` is `null` both for an API key in the default Workspace and for a principal-bound API key that has no Workspace.

type.title: Type
type.description: Scope type. Always `"organization"`: the API key has no Workspace. Only a principal-bound API key can have this scope.

service_account_id.title: Service Account Id
service_account_id.description: ID of the Service Account the API key acts as.

type.title: Type
type.description: Principal type. Always `"service_account_actor"` for a Service Account.

type.title: Type
type.description: Principal type. Always `"user_actor"` for a User.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: ID of the User the API key acts as.

type.title: Type
type.description: Scope type. Always `"workspace"`: the API key belongs to one Workspace.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: ID of the Workspace the API key belongs to. Unlike the deprecated top-level `workspace_id`, this is the Workspace's real ID even for the organization's default Workspace.

id.title: Id
id.description: ID of the actor that created the object.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of the actor that created the object.
